Q_M_trace.instructions: A build instrumented with per-phase tracing (fprintf at each phase boundary) times a phase at 2 ms. Judge the claim: that number must not be used to decide whether the phase is worth optimising.

criteria.true: The claim holds: the trace calls change the whole function's code generation, so such a build says WHICH path ran and what share each phase took, never a price against a normal build
criteria.false: The claim fails: the traced build runs the same code, so its phase timing is usable

Q_SZ_networks.instructions: Branchless Batcher sorting networks for 4-16 elements replacing insertion sort in the leaf. Rate the speedup on RANDOM calls at n=16, one thread.

Q_MECH_lattice_idle.instructions: logos-sort's lattice counting route at 14 threads shows only 8.4 of 14 threads busy on average, with NONE waiting at a barrier and no preemption (cpu/busy = 1.00). Every thread is handed exactly n/P work in both of its parallel phases. Which is the binding constraint?

criteria.serial_merge: the serial merge between the two parallel phases
criteria.table_teardown: freeing the per-thread count tables at the end
criteria.thread_creation: creating and joining the worker threads, paid once per parallel phase
criteria.memory_bandwidth: the emit phase saturating memory bandwidth, so extra threads cannot help
criteria.thread_imbalance: unequal work per thread inside the phases
criteria.cache_pressure: the per-thread tables being too large for L2
